`interface IResourceResolver`<br/>
**Known subtypes:** [`BufferedImageResourceResolver`](/reference/bridges/bufferedimageresourceresolver/), [`TextureResourceResolver`](/reference/bridges/textureresourceresolver/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.resource.resolver` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [IResourceResolver.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/resource/resolver/IResourceResolver.java)

Turns an input that is not a file, a URL or an asset, such as a texture of the host, into a resource.

## Description

`Resource.of(...)` asks the resolvers, from the last registered, for the first that supports its input.

## Learn more

- [Write the resolver](/build/resource-resolvers/#write-the-resolver)
